description: The bar chart illustrates sample counts for four essay genres, with two side-by-side bars per genre representing two conditions indicated by the legend (a light blue series labeled “Open” and a light pink series with no visible text label). The horizontal axis contains the genre categories in left-to-right order: Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, with no axis label shown and no sorting beyond this displayed order. The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Sample Count,” shown on a linear scale with tick marks at regular 20-unit intervals from 0 up to 120 (with bars extending slightly above 120). For Argumentative, the light blue Open bar is labeled 79 and the light pink bar is labeled 122; for Narrative, the Open bar is 80 and the light pink bar is 87; for Descriptive, the Open bar is 68 and the light pink bar is 100; for Expository, the Open bar is 62 and the light pink bar is 130. Each bar has its numeric value annotated above the bar top, and there are no stacked components or additional visual emphasis beyond the color coding and labels.
